fields.status: Release v0.1.1 (2026-10-14) is current. It adds Circle Pad/C-Stick dead zones, louder sound, and fixes a black ground square beside houses. The project remains in development; the release reports choppy frame rate in the busiest areas and says original 3DS/2DS is untested. It supports only the New 3DS family and the USA GAFE01 revision 0 disc.

sources.label: Maintainer README: current development state and supported hardware

fields.status: Release v1.0.7 was published 2026-10-15 and fixes partner battle-move icons, key-item labels, and choice-box appearance. The maintainer’s release notes report 60 fps on the New 3DS family and about 30 fps on original 3DS/2DS using the CIA build; users must provide their own US or EU Paper Mario ROM.

sources.label: Maintainer README: platform support and current build

fields.status: The regular New 3DS port is a playable community milestone; its current README reports 60 fps in most 1v1 stages and steady 30 fps in casual four-player matches on large stages, and says further regular-port development is not currently planned. Release v1.3.1 (2026-10-04) changed the Windows builder, not the game files. Separate Slippi Direct beta v0.1.0 (2026-10-05) adds direct 1v1 play against Slippi Dolphin on PC, but has no rollback on the 3DS and does not support Ranked, Unranked, Teams, or spectating.

sources.label: Maintainer README: regular port status and performance
